items.title: Why is I-CAR updating courses?
bodyHtml: I-CAR updates courses to keep pace with rapidly evolving vehicle technology, OEM repair requirements, and new industry standards. Updates are guided by the Industry Knowledge & Skills Protocol, ensuring technicians receive training aligned with the necessary information professionals need to perform complete, safe, and quality repairs.

items.title: How will course updates affect my current training path?
body: Most updates are designed to fit naturally into your existing training path. If a course you need is being replaced or revised, I-CAR will communicate the change and provide updated course options.

items.title: Will I need to retake courses I've already completed?
body: Not necessarily. Course update requirements depend on the role, training path, and the significance of the update. When refreshed training is required, I-CAR will make that clear.

items.title: Are the updated courses online, in-person, or both?
body: Updated courses may be offered online, instructor-led, hands-on, or through newer immersive formats depending on the learning objective.

items.title: How often will this page be updated?
body: This page is intended to stay current as new course updates are announced and launched.

items.title: Where can I view the full list of updates?
body: Use the See All Updates button above to download the latest course updates PDF.
